sections.title: Tool description for the app
sections.what: Gives the tool's slug, name, short subtitle describing the audience, its LIVE status, its icon and its page path. The shape check means these fields must match what the app expects.
sections.why: Lets the app list and link to the Opportunity Map.
sections.watch_out: Changing the path or slug changes the address the tool is reached at, so links elsewhere may break.

summary: Registers the Opportunity Map as a tool in the app, giving its name, short description, status, icon and web address.
purpose: Lets the app's tool list and navigation show the Opportunity Map with the right title and link.
why: Likely reason: the app needs one place to describe each tool. The code does not state this.
how: Exports a plain object with the tool's slug, name, subtitle, status LIVE, a compass icon and the page path. The object is checked against the shared tool shape, without the component, so any missing field is reported when the code is built.
inputs: None at runtime. The values are fixed in the file.
outputs: A tool description used by the app's tool list and router.
risks: Changing the path or slug can break links to the tool. A status of LIVE may show the tool to all users in the list.
debug: If the tool is missing from the list, check that this object is exported and registered in the tool index. If the link is wrong, check the path value.
